headline: Pakistan Prime Minister Directs Banks to Ease Lending Requirements for SMEs
summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif directed banks to ease lending requirements for SMEs, permitting business cash flows and digital export records to serve as collateral.
why: Measures improving credit access for small and medium-sized enterprises stimulate domestic economic activity and commercial bank loan growth.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Directives alter regulatory and lending frameworks for domestic banks.
